name: Honma Hiyori
source:
A newbie sex officer who joined Vaginville’s Office of Sexual Affairs at the same time as Jin. A regular pervert, she’s both cheerful and serious, and is completely up front about her sexual appetites. Her grades were poor at sex school, and she was on the verge of dropping out, so it’s a miracle she passed the employment exam at all. Her favorite sexual activities include being a cum dumpster and being used in general (though she is bad at sex, she enjoys it a lot).
